stem: Damian has not effectively stated the position he is taking in this paper. Which of the following could best replace sentence 7 and provide a stronger position statement for Damian's paper?

options.label: A
options.text: Can you believe this outrageous statistic?

options.label: B
options.text: This low voter turnout is appalling, and all Americans should exercise their right to vote.

options.label: C
options.text: I plan to vote in both national and local elections.

options.label: D
options.text: There are groups that review human rights violations in this country as well as in other countries around the world.
